name: Mattermost
description: Mattermost is a collaboration platform available as independently administered cloud and self-managed deployments with channels, messages, playbooks, integrations, and APIs.
agentUseSummary: Mattermost cannot currently be connected because its OAuth client is registered separately on each customer server and receives every permission of the authorizing user rather than granular scopes. Customer-owned bot accounts and non-expiring personal access tokens are materially different credential products, so Relay requires an explicit choice of identity and authority before defining actions.

blocked.label: Connect per-instance OAuth
blocked.description: Every independently administered server must enable OAuth and register Relay, and the resulting token inherits all permissions of the authorizing user without granular scopes.

blocked.label: Register clients dynamically
blocked.description: Dynamic Client Registration is disabled by default and exposes a public unauthenticated registration endpoint when an administrator enables it, so Relay will not assume or require it.

blocked.label: Use a bot or personal token
blocked.description: Bot accounts and personal access tokens are customer-owned non-OAuth identity products with server-specific roles and broad or non-expiring authority.

blocked.label: Access Mattermost data
blocked.description: Users, teams, channels, posts, threads, direct messages, files, reactions, playbooks, webhooks, plugins, configuration, compliance data, exports, and every read or write remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Use raw Mattermost access
blocked.description: Arbitrary origins, paths, REST endpoints, raw tools, pagination, and automatic retries are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until Relay selects and governs one exact per-instance user or bot identity model.

runtimeSupport.description: No Mattermost identity, authority, or wrapper contract is authorized to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No Mattermost identity, authority, or wrapper contract is authorized to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Mattermost OAuth is per customer server and mirrors the authorizing user's full effective permissions; bot accounts and personal tokens are distinct non-OAuth credential products, so no truthful default connection model exists.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request instance credentials or show Connect. Reconsider after an explicit product/security decision selects per-instance confidential OAuth, a least-privilege member bot, or another narrowly governed customer-owned identity and accepts its effective authority.

evidence.supports: Mattermost documents per-server client registration, OAuth disabled by default, optional confidential-client S256, refresh tokens, user/app revocation, and tokens that can perform every action available to the authorizing user.
Mattermost documents Dynamic Client Registration as disabled by default and warns that enabling it exposes an unauthenticated public client-registration endpoint.
Personal access tokens are non-expiring equivalents of user session tokens and carry all privileges of their user, including administrator authority when issued for an administrator.
Bot accounts are separate customer-managed identities with token and membership/role authority rather than delegated user OAuth.
